title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → Institution
architecture_notes: Workday models the home institution through the Academic Unit hierarchy (the top Academic Unit) and the Company used for finance. Other schools a student attended are Educational Institution objects. Equivalent PeopleSoft records: PS_INSTITUTION_TBL (home) and PS_EXT_ORG_TBL (external).

source_objects.description: The home institution in Workday Student.
The legal entity used by Workday Financials. Usually one per institution; carries the tax ID and address.
External schools referenced by transfer credit, prior education, and admissions. Carries CEEB and other codes.

validate: Workday object and field names vary by release and tenant. VALIDATE against your tenant's report data sources before building extracts.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from Academic Unit Reference_ID (home) or Educational Institution Reference_ID (external).
Array of {system, value}: workday_reference_id, ceeb, ipeds_unit_id, opeid, fice.
Map to the HELIX values; fall back to IPEDS level and control.
Load from the Carnegie Classification public file by IPEDS Unit ID. Refresh when a new edition is published.
IANA name, for example America/New_York. Set once per institution or campus.
'workday' for the home institution. Null for external schools.
